about.title: The House INTIMISSIME
about.heading: The Harmony of Refinement and Culinary Passion
about.text: Born from a desire to offer Lomé an exceptional dining scene, INTIMISSIME invites you on a culinary journey. In a contemporary setting blending warm woodwork, dark marble and gentle amber lighting, our Chef and brigade elevate Atlantic seafood and Togolese vegetables with uncompromising fine-dining rigor.
about.quote: « Cooking means unveiling the pure emotion in each ingredient to craft an enduring memory for every guest. »
valuesDesc: Minute-precise cookery, rich slow-simmered jus and harmonious seasoning.
Close partnerships with local artisanal fishermen and coastal farmers in Togo.
Personalized white-glove hospitality worthy of the finest international tables.
